population: ia_actions REVIEWED_ANALYST_UNION; ia_crypto reviewer-present consensus of amended unprotected crypto; COMPLETE or DEGRADED, no taint

directional_threshold.ia_actions: every reviewer KEEP directional view; UP p>0.50 or DOWN p<0.50, probability controls size

sizing.formula: signed name_cap * horizon_fraction * abs(p_outperform - 0.50) / 0.30; horizon_fraction=0.5 for 1d, 0.1 for each 5d cohort; pro-rata scale new lots to remaining gross and short capacity; deterministic asset/horizon order; floor shares or crypto 1e-8; divide sizing price by a 1.10 reserve factor
sizing.cohorts: half the capital allocation for 1d, half for five overlapping 5d cohorts; cap total absolute lots per name including pending intents
sizing.reference: causal decision input last close for OPG; fresh decision bid/ask midpoint for after-hours
sizing.caps: private grant, asserted in code; no leverage; all pending entry intents reserve risk; no automatic position discrepancy repair

orders.idempotency: sha256(run_id, symbol, purpose) first 40 hex; durable intent before submission; lookup before POST; recovery never reschedules a missed auction
orders.lot_identity: sha256(run_id, asset, horizon); broker target is sum of live signed lot quantities; orders are deltas
orders.netting: Opposing live lots share a broker position; allocate cumulative partial fills in broker quantity units by largest remainders. Zero entry delta is NOT_TRADED; zero exit delta is internal settlement, never claimed as a broker fill.
orders.daily_cap_reservation: Before entries, reserve one order per symbol exiting today, including new 1d lots. Admit entry deltas in deterministic symbol order within the remaining 40/day budget.
orders.claude_book: Account suffix 2EQN remains GET-only, outside every AI variant and baseline.
orders.crypto_partial_fills: V2 intents allocate cumulative crypto fills in native 1e-9 broker units (verified min_trade_increment); entry quantities retain 1e-8 flooring. Previous-spec intents retain their frozen 1e-8 allocation units. Whole-share equity precision is unchanged.

timing.equity_entry: whole-share market OPG, before open minus 2 minutes; open-entry label sessions
timing.equity_exit: market CLS, between label session close minus 20 and minus 10 minutes; pinned calendar handles holidays, early closes, DST
timing.crypto_entry: market gtc immediately after the successful daily decision; record anchor tracking difference
timing.crypto_exit: market gtc at label exit timestamp, hourly :30Z scheduler matches 13:30Z anchors

after_hours.entry: after regular close until 19:30 America/New_York; equity-only distinct prediction population; actual paper fill price or decision quote if no fill, marked NOT_TRADED
after_hours.quote_source: operator-provided private bid/ask feed until a separate market-data grant exists; unavailable quotes refuse execution
after_hours.exit: unchanged catch-up horizon, next session close for 1d and fifth following session close for 5d
after_hours.scoring: broker execution outcomes apart from open-entry and close-entry shadow predictions; unfilled entries are NOT_TRADED
after_hours.limitation: paper fills in thin after-hours liquidity are optimistic
after_hours.daily_model_budget: Pinned to the failed daily session during after-hours recovery, including across UTC midnight; no quota refund.
after_hours.unfilled: Cancel known outstanding entries at the 19:30 New York cutoff, reconcile final cumulative fills, and mark unfilled lots NOT_TRADED.

storage: append-only private ResearchStore journal; grant/spec binding; account suffix only; broker order identities hashed; no bodies or credentials
kill_switch: equity below 90% of observed peak (initial base 100000); halt persistently, cancel known pending orders and flatten broker-reconciled lots, retain all order caps; operator required to resume
limitations: Marked price changes and opening gaps can exceed intended weights; refuse new risk while marked caps are breached; scheduled exits remain enabled.
Crypto actual entry differs from the fixed research label anchor.
No result is confirmatory; all execution variants are exploratory.

benchmark_baselines.SPY_QQQ: observed open of first execution session
benchmark_baselines.BTC: fixed 13:30Z anchor of first execution session, only if unprotected

selection.keep: Every issued UP/DOWN from either analyst with reviewer KEEP; DOWNGRADE, REJECT, ABSTAIN and MISSING never contribute. Probability controls size under the existing formula; share flooring and risk/timing caps still apply.
selection.conflict: Any issued UP versus DOWN on the same asset and horizon vetoes the trade, even if one view was downgraded or rejected.
selection.deduplication: One lot per asset/horizon; when both are eligible and agree use p closest to 0.50; deterministic analyst tie-break.
selection.ia_crypto: Consensus execution retained; long or flat only.
selection.scores: Consensus and existing analyst/reviewer variants remain computed and scored under unchanged primary shadow rules.

rebinding: Explicit operator-decision hash, prior binding identity/spec/grant and new spec/preregistration/base/amendment hashes appended to the private journal under owner lock. Refuse open lots, nonterminal intents, broker positions or open orders in either AI account. Original grants and historical events remain immutable. Old stores rejected without this explicit transition.
